source_detail: WHO recommends adults reduce sodium intake to <2 g/day (5 g/day salt).
notes: Apply to the total planned daily intake, not as a blanket per-100g food cutoff.

source_detail: Higher sodium intake is associated with higher blood pressure; WHO recommends reducing sodium intake.
notes: Use sodium density for ranking after hard daily-sodium constraints.

source_detail: ADA 2026 recommends limiting sodium to <2,300 mg/day, as clinically appropriate, for people with diabetes.
notes: This is a daily target; do not turn it into a blanket per-100g cutoff.

source_detail: ADA recommends high-fiber carbohydrate sources, at least 14 g fiber per 1,000 kcal.
notes: Convert the user's calorie target to a daily fiber target before meal planning.

source_detail: ADA emphasizes nonstarchy vegetables, whole fruits, legumes, lean proteins, whole grains, nuts/seeds, and low-fat dairy or alternatives.
notes: This requires category/attribute mapping; it is a ranking rule, not a binary medical exclusion.

source_detail: ADA recommends minimizing sweets, refined grains, sugar-sweetened beverages, and processed/ultraprocessed foods.
notes: Your current dataset lacks an explicit added-sugar field and detailed processing taxonomy, so these rules need attribute enhancement before hard exclusion.

source_detail: User-declared allergies must be treated as hard exclusions.
notes: Only enforce this when food ingredient/allergen attributes are verified; unknown should not be treated as safe.
